description: What the AI-labelling laws of the given markets ask of an AI-generated image, video, audio file, 3D model or text, and what a call to POST /v1/mark must send for them: the fields required, whether the visible label is needed, and what can't be marked yet. Answers from the rules the API itself enforces, and lists each market's other rules as the law map does (rules for some sectors only, drafts), with what our marks cover of each and links to the government texts.

deepfake.description: Whether the files realistically depict real people, places or events (deep fakes). Default false.

markets.description: The countries the app serves, comma-separated, at most 8 ("us" counts as 3): ISO codes (de, jp, br), "eu", US states (us-ca) or "us" for California, Washington and Utah (us-ca, us-wa, us-ut), which doesn't cover the other states' rules yet. Profiles: eu, us-ca, us-wa, us-ut, kr, in.

media.description: The kind of file the app generates.

public_interest.description: Text only: published to inform the public on matters of public interest, with no human review (the EU AI Act's Art. 50(4)). Default false.

name: get_requirements
title: AI-labelling rules for markets
